name: Golden Pride

features.name: Expanding lion wild
features.description: Expands to fill its reel when it lands.

features.name: Progressive respins
features.description: Non-winning respins raise a multiplier that can reach 1,024x.

review:
A lion king defends his pride on 243 ways. The lion wild expands over his whole reel whenever he lands.

If he doesn't make a win, he kicks off a respin round instead – and every respin without a win raises a multiplier that can reach 1,024x. So a miss in the base game isn't wasted; it sets up the bonus. Medium-high volatility, a 15,360x max and 96% RTP. A clever twist.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
